title: Creamy Irish Kale Chowder
description: A comforting and creamy Irish-inspired kale chowder that is easy to make and perfect for a cold day. This recipe is gluten-free.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the diced potatoes, chopped kale, and Irish chowder.
Pour in the heavy cream and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional kale if desired.
